v2_training_iteration.goal: Improve performance by adding more banana data and extending training to 32K steps

pipeline.record: 29 episodes (15 plum, 10 banana, 4 lemon), 10113 frames, merged from 4 recording sessions
pipeline.train: 32000 steps; ~90min; final loss 0.016; checkpoints at 8K/16K/24K/32K steps
pipeline.eval: 3 episodes per checkpoint (8K/16K/32K) on plum and banana

results.finding: Severe overfitting: additional banana data and extended training degraded performance from 25% to 0%
results.root_cause: Distribution shift from banana_v2 data collection patterns; overfitting to specific training trajectories

v2_training_iteration.status: ARCHIVED_AS_FAILED_EXPERIMENT — demonstrates importance of data quality and training duration; v11 checkpoint remains best (25% overall)
